notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content:
[h1]🏁 DEMO NOW AVAILABLE! 🏁[/h1]
[h2]Start your engines – Ed & Edda invite you to take a test drive![/h2]

Full speed ahead to release!
The playable demo of Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions is now available for free on Steam.
This action-packed racing game, featuring the beloved Europa-Park mascots, will officially launch on July 24, 2025 – right in time for the German cinema release of the movie GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE.
New screenshots offer a fresh look at the colorful tracks and detailed characters of the game. 🌍

[h3]Feature Highlights[/h3]
• Fast-paced races: Tracks across Europe featuring famous landmarks
• High speed: Thanks to multiple boost mechanics
• Eight playable characters: Including Ed & Edda – the Europa-Park stars
• Tons of variety: Customizable vehicles, power-ups, and different game modes
• Multiplayer fun: Up to four players locally on one console or PC

[h3]👉 Try it now and let us know what you think – we’re excited to hear your feedback! 💬[/h3]

[h2]You can watch the official trailer for Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions on YouTube![/h2]

Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions is a vibrant, family-friendly racing game developed in close collaboration with Europa-Park in Rust, Germany. Launching alongside the worldwide release of the animated movie Grand Prix of Europe, it brings the park’s beloved mascots Ed & Edda to life in a video game for the very first time.
The game will be released on Nintendo Switch, Playstation 5, XBox Series and on PC via Steam in July this year!

notes.title: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions
notes.content:
[h2][b]🏁 Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions 🏁[/b][/h2]
Your adventure on the fast lane starts in July 2025 on Steam!

Get ready for a thrilling racing experience full of fun and adventure! [b]Tivola Games, Funatics[/b], and [b]MACK Magic[/b] bring the beloved Europa-Park mascots Ed & Edda to your console and PC – as the [b]official video game adaptation[/b] of the [b]Europa-Park[/b] movie "GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE"!

[h3][b]What awaits you:[/b][/h3]

🚗 [b]Travel across Europe:[/b] Race through spectacular tracks set in world-famous cities like London, Paris, and Cannes!

💨 [b]Faster than ever before:[/b] Outpace typical kart racers – experience the speed of true racing games!

🔵 [b]Blue Energy Boost:[/b] Collect or charge up blue energy by drifting and unleash powerful speed boosts, just like in the movie!

🛞 [b]Customize your racer:[/b] Personalize your car with colors, horns, trail effects, and skins!

🎯 [b]Point Race Mode:[/b] Earn points during the race – not just your finishing position, but your performance determines the winner!

🎮 [b]Easy to pick up, challenging to master:[/b] Jump right into the action, but true mastery takes skill – for long-term fun!

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 [b]Racing for everyone:[/b] Race solo or compete against family and friends – and become the ultimate Racing Champion!

Are you ready to become the ultimate Racing Champion?
Follow us for updates, exclusive insights, and first gameplay reveals!

[h3]👉 Add to your [b]wishlist[/b] now and never miss an update![/h3]
